title: Mass Cytometry: Protocol for Daily Tuning and Running Cell Samples on a CyTOF Mass Cytometer
protocol: Open the CyTOF software program.
Select Instrument Setup.
Go to the Card Cage tab and click Heater "ON" button in the lower right corner.
Turn on the heater at least 15 min prior to desired time.
Replace the white Norm-Ject 3 ml syringe with a fresh one filled with MilliQ water.
Clean nebulizer by backflushing with 5% citranox through both liquid and gas introduction ports 2-3 times.
Repeat backflushing with MilliQ water to remove residual citranox.
Open argon gas tank valve.
Attach the nebulizer to the make-up gas inlet.
Unscrew the make-up gas tubing connector and remove the black rubber o-ring and the white conical plastic piece.
Place the connector on the gas introduction port of the nebulizer.
Place the black o-ring over the end of the gas port, and force it past the wider part of the port stem.
Place the white conical plastic piece on top with the narrow end pointed out, and screw onto the make-up gas tubing.
Attach the nebulizer to the liquid introduction tubing.
Carefully insert the small tubing into the opening at the end of the nebulizer until meeting light resistance.
Press harder to force the end of the straight section of glass further into the fitting.
Tighten the screw fitting to seal.
Insert the end of the nebulizer into the white opening in the heating mantle.
Press "Start Plasma" on the RFG Controller tab of the Instrument Setup window.
Since the nebulizer is already inserted, press "OK".
The software will turn on the chiller, start the flow of gas, and ignite a plasma.
Wait for the detector voltage to ramp up.
When the pop-up window appears saying "Plasma start-up sequence has finished successfully", press "OK".
Turn on the syringe pump for the mass cytometer.
Press the green "play" button to start the syringe pump and begin flowing liquid through the tubing and spraying out of the nebulizer.
Refill the syringe when it runs out of water by hitting the "stop" button rather than the blue "pause" button.
Click the Isotopes Per Reading button.
Select "Pulses Count".
Rescale the y-axis by entering a new number and pressing "enter".
Fill a green 1 ml Norm-Ject syringe with tuning solution.
Turn the sample port selector to "LOAD".
Inject 450 μl of tuning solution.
Turn the selector to "INJECT".
In the Mass Calibration tab of the Data Acquisition Settings window, press "Run".
Monitor which masses are flowing by.
Wait until tuning solution isotopes start appearing as streaks in this display.
Go back to the Mass(es) Per Reading window.
Press the green "Play" button in the upper left corner.
Select "Current" from the drop-down menu on the Parameter tab of the Data Acquisition Settings window.
Set start=0, finish=10, step value=0.5, and settling time=200.
Click save.
Return to the Mass(es) Per Reading window and hit play.
Note where the signals of the isotopes peak with the x-axis set as "Current".
Enter the new current value under the DAC Channels Setup tab of the Instrument Setup window.
Press "Set actual current value", then "save".
Change drop-down menu to "Make-up gas."
Let start=0.55, end=0.95, step value=0.05, settling time=200.
Click save.
Return to the Mass(es) Per Reading window and hit play.
Record where the signals of the isotopes peak with the x-axis set as "Make-up gas" flow rate.
Enter the new make-up gas value under the DAC Channels Setup tab.
Press "Set actual current value", then "save".
Make a second 450 μl injection of tuning solution.
Select "Time" from the drop-down menu on the Parameter tab, let start=0, end=10, step value=1, settling time=200.
Press "save."
Hit "play" in Mass(es) Per Reading window.
Inject 3 ml of MilliQ water through the sample loop.
Follow by injecting 500 μl of DVS Wash Solution.
Monitor the progress of cleaning by pressing "run" in the Mass Calibration tab.
Wash until the intensity of the streaks begins to decrease, then follow by 3 ml of MilliQ water.
Monitor until down to background levels.
Open the Acquisition window.
Enter the file name.
Save all files to the E:// drive.
Set acquisition delays with a total of at least 30 seconds including a detector stability delay of at least 20 seconds.
Set data collection time to run samples for 50-100 seconds after loading the sample loop.
Wash cell staining equipment twice with MilliQ water after staining to minimize salt buildup.
Resuspend cells in MilliQ water, aiming for approximately 106 cells per milliliter.
Filter resuspended cells through a cell strainer to remove aggregates.
Enter a new file name for the current sample in preparation for analysis.
Switch the sample loop valve to "LOAD" position before injecting the sample.
Inject the prepared sample into the system.
Switch the sample loop valve back to "INJECT" position after injection.
Hit "Run" in the Acquisition window to start the data collection process.
Register cell events in the snapshot window as horizontal collections of marks.
Adjust cell event registration rate to 300-500 cells/sec for better resolution.
Observe the cell event counter starting to climb after up to 30 seconds due to on-the-fly data processing.
Monitor background streaking in each isotope channel during acquisition.
Check the cell event rate while acquiring sample data.
Diminish background signal from free metal or unbound antibody by additional washes or greater cell dilution.
Minimize doublet events by increasing cell dilution, which may increase run time.
Finish sample data acquisition when the Acquisition time is reached.
Wait for a pop-up window with an "OK" button to appear after data processing.
Stop sample acquisition prematurely by hitting the "Stop" button if necessary.
Inject at least 500 μl of MilliQ water between each sample to minimize carryover.
After the final sample, flush the sample loop with water and inject 450 μl of wash solution into the sample loop.
Monitor the release of free metal in the Mass Calibration tab as described in Step 2.8.
Flush with 3 ml of MilliQ water when the free metal signal begins to decrease.
Continue flushing until background levels are achieved.
Select "Stop Plasma" in the RFG Controller tab of the Instrument Setup window.
Press "OK" when prompted to remove the nebulizer.
Turn off the heater in the Card Cage tab.
Close the valve on the argon supply.
Remove the nebulizer from the spray chamber by pulling it backwards carefully.
Unscrew the sample introduction tubing and set aside.
Loosen the make-up gas introduction connection, then pull the nebulizer off.
Backflush both ports of the nebulizer with 5% citranox using a syringe and tubing.
Store the nebulizer covered in 5% citranox until next use.
